page.overview:
Who is Banno?

Banno was a male Bothan Lieutenant who served in the Grand Army of the Republic as a starfighter pilot during the Clone Wars. Around 22 BBY, Banno held the rank as lieutenant and was stationed on Azure under the command of General Solomahal. When they were ambushed by the Separatists, Banno fought alongside Commander Anakin Skywalker in the battle.
